evals.prompt: We built a small static web tool called Soly Lite outside the ZeroOrigine pipeline (one HTML page plus a tiny API that calls Claude). Write the exact, ordered runbook to adopt it into the ZeroOrigine ecosystem as slug `solylite`: the database layer on zo-platform, the API door, schedules, repo, hosting, shared auth and beacon, the registry rows, and the proof. Name the concrete tables, config keys, API calls and the order-dependent traps. Output a markdown runbook. Do NOT execute anything against production; this is a written plan only.
evals.expected_output: An ordered runbook naming zo_config-held tokens used only from Postgres, RLS with zero policies plus revoke, append-only triggers, brakes (PAUSE and DAILY_BUDGET), pg_cron with the secret read in SQL, the adoption grant sequence (grant row, insert without adopted_at, update to launched, zo_products, zo_product_core_action, grant deleted), beacon after registration, real-browser verification.
expectations: Names the adoption grant key zo_adoption_grant
Warns that metadata must not carry adopted_at before the update to launched
Includes a zo_product_core_action row so the served gate can count the product
Tokens used only from inside Postgres (extensions.http or net.http_post reading zo_config)
RLS with zero policies and privileges revoked from anon/authenticated
Brakes as config keys: SOLYLITE_PAUSE and SOLYLITE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
Beacon returns 401 beacon_slug_exists until the zo_products row exists
Proof in a real browser, not grep of fetched HTML
Output contains no em or en dash
